name: Outlook
description: Read and manage Outlook mail, calendars, contacts and directory profiles using a local browser sign-in.
capabilities: Create drafts, send mail and manage folders
reviewNotes: Opt-in session recovery candidate. Serialized refresh and atomic token rotation are feature gated. Native authenticated Windows acceptance and internal trials remain pending.
prerequisites: A coding agent with shell access, or a terminal
An installed Chrome or Edge browser
A Microsoft account with access to Outlook Web
authentication: Run outlook_login to try automatic session import first. Approve any Keychain prompt yourself, or complete Microsoft sign-in and MFA in the dedicated browser if needed. Let the window close itself.
Session data stays outside the bundle in the upstream OS-specific msoutlook-mcp-server directory.
